steps.title: Twin Longitudinal Box Girders & Underbody Skid Keel (L1)

partsTray.note: Authored placements only; not a complete BOM.
Authored placements only; not a complete BOM.

instructions: Build the primary foundation spine of the locomotive from Z +17 to +25 at Level L1.
Lay two parallel Heavy Armor box girders at X = −2 and X = +2 spanning Z +17 to +25 at Level L1.
Tie the girders together with transverse cross-beams at Z = +17, Z = +21, and Z = +25.
Install continuous Heavy Armor Half-Blocks along centerline X0, forming a flat underside skid plate providing 1.25 m clearance above ground.
Bevel the girder outer edges using Heavy Armor Half-Slopes sloping inward toward X0.
checks: Check both box girders are tied at Z +17, +21, and +25, with the center keel clear of the conveyor spine.
